content: Melvin-Koushki states that the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ 'was completed on 1 Shaʿbān 823/11 August 1420 (MS Landberg 146) or 19 Dhū l-Ḥijja 823/25 December 1420 (MS Majlis 10196), perhaps in Isfahan or Yazd, and revised and expanded in 828/1425'; a footnote says the later date is supported by an entry in ʿAbd Allāh Afandī's Riyāḍ al-ʿUlamāʾ.
